name: Telephone game
summary: A two-player pure coordination game about who redials after a dropped phone call.
rules_text: Two players have just been cut off on a single telephone line. Simultaneously and without communication, each chooses one action: Wait or Call. If both choose Wait, no connection occurs and both get 0. If both choose Call, both get a busy signal and both get 0. If one Calls and the other Waits, the call connects. In the simple version both receive a positive payoff (e.g., 10 each). In the costly version the Waiter receives more (e.g., 6) than the Caller who pays the cost (e.g., 3). A caller role may be assigned initially for story but does not affect actions.
rating_reason: Two-player coordination game with multiple equilibria.
